source: Pew Research Center. American Trends Panel Wave 70, fielded July 13-19, 2020.
method: Population is respondent's religious tradition (F_RELTRAD). Share NOT answering "I do not donate" on CONGDONATE_W70 ("since the start of the coronavirus outbreak, how much money have you donated to the house of worship you attend most often") - i.e. any regular congregational giving, whether more, less, or about the same as usual; refused excluded from each row's denominator. Groups under 30 valid respondents omitted. Weighted by the dataset's own WEIGHT_W70 variable.
